chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Ibn Ri'ab from Abu Ubaydah said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever gives fatwa to the people without knowledge and guidance from God, the angels of mercy and the angels of punishment will curse him, and the burden of sin of those who act upon his fatwa will be attached to him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for someone who issues religious rulings without knowledge?
ai.summary: In the context of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith underscores the gravity of *fatwa* as a serious scholarly duty, warning that issuing rulings without true knowledge (*'ilm*) and divine guidance (*hudan*) incurs a dual curse from both the angels of mercy and punishment. This dual attribution highlights the comprehensive nature of the error, affecting both spiritual standing and accountability. Furthermore, the issuer bears the cumulative burden (*wazr*) of the deeds of all followers, emphasizing the profound social and spiritual responsibility of the *muftee*.
